en: Black-and-white postcard view of a calm river with reflections of trees and buildings along the opposite bank. On the right side, a row of wooden houses and larger villa-style buildings line a road above the riverbank, with tall, thin trees behind them. To the left, a covered or truss bridge crosses the river. The scene is rural and wooded, and printed caption text appears at the bottom left and right corners.
